title: Fix feedback page to use caller-scoped feedback retrieval

requirements.summary: Update the feedback React Query hook to fetch the signed-in caller’s feedback via the caller-scoped backend method so non-admin users can view their own feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/hooks/useFeedback.ts uses the caller-scoped backend method (e.g., actor.getCallerFeedback()) for the ['feedback','caller'] query.
A signed-in non-admin user can load /feedback and see their previous feedback entries (if any) without receiving an authorization error.
Submitting feedback still works and the list updates after submission via React Query invalidation.
No changes are made to any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

file_operations.description: Replace the current admin-only feedback retrieval (getAllFeedback) with the caller-scoped backend capability (getCallerFeedback) for the ['feedback','caller'] query. Keep React Query behavior consistent (enabled gating via actor availability, retry: false) and preserve existing invalidation so the list refreshes after submit. Use the authorization component’s guidance for authenticated data access (only fetch app data when logged in; handle Unauthorized traps gracefully via existing UI error mapping). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
